_help.about: What the player can carry and wear (Inventory; the inventory screen on Tab, or I). Restart the game after editing. Spec Appendix R4: a handful of items, weight felt in movement (movement table 'burden'), never read in a menu.
_help.sample_reach_m: How near a plant must be (from your hands) for E to take a sample of it.
_help.carry_slots: How many things you can carry. Each slot holds one thing: a bundle of herbs, a plant sample, a cut cactus column, a fish, a mushroom.
_help.starting_kit: The two tools of the whole game (design §M, §T; the fishing pole shelved 29 Sept 2026 for a separate fishing game, the spear fishes), plus a quiver of arrows (data/combat.json quiver.start). You wake empty-handed (a new game and after a death alike: Mike, 29 Sept 2026) and the folk who saved you have laid these on the ground by you, a gift: right click takes each into its slot. There are no other tools, ever: no axes, picks, shovels, knives or stone tools, and no tool crafting.
_help.equipment: The slots you wear things in: how many are worn and how many spares each keeps. The two tools (bow, spear) are one each with NO spares (design §T: three tools, never more); amulet one worn and two spares; rings two worn and two spares. Spares don't count as carried.
_help.kinds: Every kind of item: its name on the screen, the little picture drawn for it (icon), and which equipment slot it's worn in (slot; none = it's carried). color is the picture's main color where the item doesn't bring its own (a plant sample takes its species' colors).
_help.sample_part: What E on a plant takes, by the plant's shape: a cutting, a seed head, a leaf, or a cut column (a cactus: its own kind of item). Shapes not listed give a cutting.
_help.bundle_genera: Plants of these genera give a bundle of herbs (cut stems, tied) instead of a sample. It still carries the species.
_help.starting_kit_ambient: Design 30 Sept §AW: what you wake with in the ambient movement profile - nothing worn, nothing laid beside you; by_the_fire is what the camp keeps (a bundle of unlit torches). starting_kit is the shinobi profile's.
_help.carried_plants: [NOT WIRED YET — design §CT] Carrying plants and watering them, an optional side layer (Mike, 3 Oct): nothing else in the game needs it. kinds: what can be carried and planted: seeds (from plants in seed, fruits and vegetables), cuttings (only from species whose propagation list has cutting), tubers and bulbs (Amorphophallus, taro). propagation_field: the per-species list (seed, cutting, tuber, bulb, division) a plant-data fill adds. A planting lives if the plot fits its niche (habitat.json communities.niche_keys) and fails otherwise (fails_when), with a log line that says why. watered_moisture_bands: watering counts a plot this many moisture bands wetter; it can't change temperature, frost or altitude, which the player picks by where they plant. watering: §AB's soil water when built; until then §BP's rule (a plot by water or a dug channel counts as watered). spreads_on_its_own false: a planting stays where it was put (first guess; open for the designer). log: the lines it adds (§AZ).

ember.name: Ember carrier
ember._note: technique ember_carrier: a live coal wrapped in bark; cold when its hours run out

fat_lamp.name: Fat lamp
fat_lamp._note: technique fat_lamp: a stone bowl of rendered fat with a moss wick

mad_honey.name: Mad honey
mad_honey._note: [NOT WIRED YET — design §CM] Dark red-brown honey from rhododendron nectar, found in wild combs in a rhododendron forest and at a honey cliff in the spring bloom. Its grayanotoxin works like the real thing: a little and the world swims and the heart slows for a few game hours; more and you sit down where you are. First guesses; the designer tunes it.

log.too_wet: The ground is too wet for it.
log.wrong_soil: It doesn't take to this soil.
